h2. QA — PASSED WITH NOTES

I tested *VCST-6011* on *vcptcore-qa* in the Admin Page Builder Designer (store B2B-store). The stand runs Platform {{3.1072.0}} and PageBuilderModule {{3.1030.0-pr-165-1ab4}}, built from [PR #165|https://github.com/VirtoCommerce/vc-module-pagebuilder/pull/165] at {{1ab4e68}}. I confirmed that build through {{/api/platform/modules}}.

The reported bug is fixed. Without clipboard permission, the section and page actions menus now open populated in *Firefox 151* and in *Edge*, 3 times out of 3 in each browser. A call counter on {{navigator.clipboard.readText}} stayed at 0 while the menus were opening, so the clipboard read no longer gates the menu. In both browsers I created a Shared Component from the Designer page menu. The page then saved, and after a reload the placement was still there with "Used on 1 page(s)". Before the fix, on the pr-159 build, the menu was empty in every attempt.

||Check||Firefox||Edge||
|Section menu without clipboard access|3/3 populated|3/3 populated|
|Page menu, Save selected as Shared Component|3/3|3/3|
|Clipboard reads while opening the menus|0|0 (also with permission denied)|
|Shared Component created, persists after reload|Pass|Pass|
|Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the row|Pass|Pass|
|Copy, then Paste with permission granted; invalid payload rejected|—|Pass|

!ff-page-menu.png|width=700!
!edge-sc-persisted.png|width=700!

h3. Notes (not blocking this ticket)

# *Paste is never disabled.* The fix comment says Paste is disabled when clipboard access is unavailable, but in both prompt and denied states it stays enabled. In Firefox, clicking Paste after waited more than 10 seconds with no paste, no manual-paste dialog and no message. In Edge with permission blocked, clicking it does nothing visible; the console logs only {{NotAllowedError}}. So the silent wait has moved from opening the menu to clicking Paste. This needs one manual check in desktop Firefox to see whether a browser paste prompt appears there.
# *Native right-click in Firefox closes at once.* The menu opens and then closes 8–13 ms later (0/3), because the mouseup/auxclick of the same right-button press counts as a click outside the menu. This was seen under Playwright, so real Windows Firefox may behave differently. The tune button works. In Edge, right-click works.

!edge-denied-section-menu-paste-enabled.png|width=700!

Not filed: pasting a copied Features section was refused with "Template Pages cannot contain section features", while Add block accepted the same section type on that page. It was seen once, in Edge, so confidence is low.
